All core behaviors are verified. Here is the design.

# Sub-design 1: Revisioned + previewable section meta (classic meta boxes in the block editor)

Source: WordPress `7.1-branch` (`wp-includes/version.php` = 7.1.1-RC1). All refs below are VERIFIED unless marked ASSUMED.

## Decision

- **One meta key per section**, `single=true`, `type=object`, full REST schema (nested `items` for repeaters, `additionalProperties=false`), `revisions_enabled=true`, canonical `default`. Keys: `hk9_sec_hero`, `hk9_sec_cards`, ... Form inputs are named **exactly** `hk9_sec_hero[heading]`, `hk9_sec_cards[items][0][title]` so core's classic autosave copies them for free.
- PHP `save_post_page` handler is the write path for classic editor + block-editor meta-box-loader; the vanilla JS additionally **mirrors** section objects into `wp.data.dispatch('core/editor').editPost({meta})` so REST save/autosave/preview carry them.
- Rejected: one key per field (dozens of keys per page → N meta copies per revision in `wp_save_revisioned_meta_fields`, huge REST `meta` object, repeaters still need arrays; diff UI gains nothing since we add a readable formatter anyway).

## Verified core behaviors

| # | Fact | Ref |
|---|---|---|
| a1 | `revisions_enabled` gates `wp_post_revision_meta_keys()`; used by `wp_save_revisioned_meta_fields` (`_wp_put_post_revision` action), `wp_check_revisioned_meta_fields_have_changed` (`wp_save_post_revision_post_has_changed`), `wp_restore_post_revision_meta` (`wp_restore_post_revision`), `wp_autosave_post_revisioned_meta_fields` (`wp_creating_autosave`), `_wp_preview_meta_filter` | revision.php:574-599; default-filters.php:800-809 |
| a2 | Revision is created on **`wp_after_insert_post` prio 9** (`wp_save_post_revision_on_insert`); the `post_updated` hook returns null early | default-filters.php:445-446; revision.php:136 |
| a3 | In `wp_insert_post`: `post_updated` → `save_post_page` → `save_post` → `wp_after_insert_post` (if `$fire_after_hooks`). So meta written in `save_post` **is captured** by the revision of the same `wp_update_post()` call | post.php:5255-5301 |
| a4 | `wp_save_revisioned_meta_fields` copies only keys where `metadata_exists()` via `_wp_copy_post_meta` → `add_metadata()` (fresh revision, no duplicates) | revision.php:402-413, 555-564 |
| b1 | REST `update_item`: `wp_update_post(..., false)` (no after-hooks) → `handle_template` (`_wp_page_template`) → `meta->update_value` → `wp_after_insert_post()` → revision includes REST-written meta | class-wp-rest-posts-controller.php:980,1015,1034,1050 |
| b2 | Meta boxes are posted only after the REST save resolves and never on autosave (`editor.savePost` action, `!options.isAutosave`); body = base form + location forms + `comment_status/ping_status/sticky/post_author`; posted to `post.php?...&meta-box-loader=1` with `action=editpost` → `edit_post()` → `wp_update_post` → second `wp_after_insert_post`. A second revision is created **only if** post fields or revisioned meta differ from the latest revision | edit-post.js:9909-9950,10020-10025; post.php(admin):236-246; revision.php:186-213,611-619 |
| b3 | Hidden fields carry no `page_template`/`post_status`; `_wp_translate_postdata` keeps previous status | wp-admin/includes/post.php:2537-2602,147-149 |
| c1 | Restore: `wp_update_post` (title/content/excerpt) → `save_post_page` fires (no nonce, GET) → new revision → then `wp_restore_post_revision_meta`: `delete_post_meta` then copy from revision; key absent in revision ⇒ deleted on post | revision.php:476-544; wp-admin/revision.php:36-71 |
| d1 | Autosave endpoint accepts `meta` (parent EDITABLE args), defines `DOING_AUTOSAVE`; for non-draft/other-author it calls `create_post_autosave($post, $meta)` which writes revisioned keys with `update_metadata('post', $revision_id, ...)`; **no schema validation** on that path. Draft-by-author branch calls `wp_update_post` **without meta** | class-wp-rest-autosaves-controller.php:108,213,248-256,378-451 |
| d2 | Block editor preview: drafts → `savePost({isPreview:true})` (full save + meta boxes); non-drafts → `autosave({isPreview:true})`. Autosave payload = `title,excerpt,content,meta` with meta merged from persisted record (`mergedEdits:{meta:true}`) | editor.js:79048-79061; core-data.js:16113,18129,18288-18310 |
| d3 | Frontend: `_show_post_preview` (init) → `the_preview` → `_set_preview` adds `_wp_preview_meta_filter`, which returns `get_post_meta($autosave->ID, ...)` for revisioned keys (latest autosave, any user) | default-filters.php:493; revision.php:869-889,1121-1139; class-wp-query.php:3578 |
| d4 | Classic preview (`post_preview` → `wp_create_post_autosave`): new autosave = `_wp_put_post_revision` (copies parent meta) then `wp_creating_autosave` → `wp_autosave_post_revisioned_meta_fields` writes `$_POST[$meta_key]` (arrays OK). Existing autosave with **unchanged title/content** is **deleted** and `0` returned → no `preview_id` → meta-only changes not previewed | wp-admin/includes/post.php:1957-2065,2074-2125 |
| e1 | Meta REST schema auto-gets `additionalProperties=false`; `update_value` validates+sanitizes by schema; `prepare_value` returns **null** for stored values failing schema; `null` on write **deletes** the key | class-wp-rest-meta-fields.php:160-201,496,556-572 |
| g1 | `sanitize_meta` uses `sanitize_post_meta_{key}_for_{subtype}`; revisions have subtype `revision` → a `page`-registered sanitizer does **not** run on revision/autosave writes | meta.php:1342-1380,1523,1798-1810 |
| g2 | `update/delete/add_post_meta` redirect revision IDs to the parent; `_metadata` variants do not | post.php:2690-2784 |

## Design

**Registration (`init`)** — `HK9\Core\Sections\Registry` holds `SectionDefinition`s (fields, defaults, `templates[]`). For every section (all templates) `register_post_meta('page', $key, [...])`: `type=object`, `single=true`, `default=$def->defaults()`, `revisions_enabled=true`, `sanitize_callback=[$def,'sanitize']`, `auth_callback=fn($allowed,$k,$post_id,$user_id)=>user_can($user_id,'edit_post',$post_id)`, `show_in_rest=['schema'=>$def->schema(), 'prepare_callback'=>fn($v,$r,$a)=>WP_REST_Meta_Fields::prepare_value($def->sanitize($v),$r,$a)]`. Also `add_filter("sanitize_post_meta_{$key}_for_revision", [$def,'sanitize'], 10, 4)` (g1). Sanitizer contract: pure, idempotent, iterates the field definition (deterministic key order), coerces types (`'12'→12`, `'1'→true`, missing→default), `wp_kses_post`/`sanitize_text_field`/`esc_url_raw`, validates IDs (`get_post_type()`), output always passes `rest_validate_value_from_schema` (unit-tested). Theme reads through `hk9_section($post_id,'hero')` = `sanitize(is_array($raw)?$raw:[])` (autosaves return `''` for unset keys because defaults are subtype-scoped).

**Meta box** — `add_meta_boxes_page` prio 10: one box per section of `get_page_template_slug($post)` (`''` = default). Renders `wp_nonce_field("hk9_sections_{$post->ID}",'hk9_sections_nonce')`, fields with `data-hk9-type`, media/relationship pickers (attachment IDs never typed).

**Save** — `save_post_page` prio 10 (3 args): bail unless `isset($_POST['hk9_sections_nonce'])` && `wp_verify_nonce` && `current_user_can('edit_post',$post_id)` && `!(DOING_AUTOSAVE)` && `!wp_is_post_revision($post_id)`. `$template = get_page_template_slug($post_id)` (already updated: post.php:5160-5171 classic; REST b1). For each section of that template: `if (isset($_POST[$key]) && is_array($_POST[$key])) update_post_meta($post_id,$key,wp_slash($def->sanitize(wp_unslash($_POST[$key]))))`. Never delete; never touch other templates' keys. Absent sub-fields (checkboxes) default via sanitizer since the root key exists.

**Classic preview fallback** — `admin_action_editpost` prio 5: if `$_POST['wp-preview']==='dopreview'`, nonce `update-post_{id}` valid, user can edit, and not (unlocked draft by author): `wp_delete_post_revision(wp_get_post_autosave($id,get_current_user_id()))` so `wp_create_post_autosave` always takes the create branch (d4): parent meta copied, then `$_POST[hk9_sec_*]` applied and sanitized via the `_for_revision` filter.

**Diff UI** — `_wp_post_revision_fields` (only when `get_current_screen()->base==='revision'`) adds each key; `_wp_post_revision_field_{key}` formats the array as labelled lines (image → filename).

**JS (vanilla)** — On `input/change` (debounced 150 ms): serialise the section form to a nested object (bracket parser + `data-hk9-type` coercion; `''`→`0` for integers) → `editPost({meta:{[key]:obj}})`. Template switch: `wp.data.subscribe` on `getEditedPostAttribute('template')` (classic: `#page_template` change) → `admin-ajax` `hk9_section_panel` (nonce, `edit_post`, template ∈ `wp_get_theme()->get_page_templates($post)`) → replace panel HTML, re-init, mirror. No reload prompt; unsaved values of the previous panel stay in the editor store and are written by REST on save.

**Order of operations**

1. *Block editor save*: REST PUT → `wp_update_post` (`save_post_page` bails: no nonce) → `_wp_page_template` → meta via `update_value` (schema + sanitizer + `edit_post_meta`) → `wp_after_insert_post` → revision R1 (post + meta) → meta-box-loader POST → `edit_post` → `save_post_page` writes same canonical values (`update_metadata` no-op) → `wp_after_insert_post` → no R2 (unchanged).
2. *Classic save*: `edit_post` → `wp_insert_post` sets template → `save_post_page` writes → `wp_after_insert_post` → one revision with meta.
3. *Block preview*: draft → flow 1; published → POST `/autosaves` with mirrored meta → `create_post_autosave` writes revisioned keys to the autosave (sanitized by `_for_revision`) → preview link with `preview_id` → `_wp_preview_meta_filter`.
4. *Classic preview*: `admin_action_editpost` deletes stale autosave → `post_preview` → new autosave + `$_POST` keys → preview.
5. *Restore*: `wp_update_post` (handler bails) → R_new (restored text + pre-restore meta, cosmetic) → `wp_restore_post_revision_meta` replaces every revisioned key from the revision.
6. *Quick/bulk edit*: `edit_post`/`wp_update_post` without nonce → handler bails; section meta untouched even when template changes.

## Edge cases

- Invalid stored value → REST `null` → next save deletes (e1). Mitigated by `prepare_callback` canonicalisation + schema-validated sanitizer.
- `_wp_page_template` is not revisioned: previews/restores render the *saved* template. Do not revision it.
- `===` comparisons (`wp_check_revisioned_meta_fields_have_changed`, `update_metadata`) need deterministic key order/types — the sanitizer guarantees it.
- REST autosave path skips schema validation; the sanitizer is the only guard there. Theme escapes on output regardless.
- Preview uses the latest autosave of any user (core limitation).
- Multiple `save_post_page` firings inside one request (e.g. `wp_update_post` in other plugins) are idempotent.

## Test plan (docker WordPress 7.1, page ID `P`, template `tpl-home`)

1. Schema: `wp eval 'var_dump(rest_validate_value_from_schema(get_registered_meta_keys("post","page")["hk9_sec_hero"]["default"], ...schema))'` → true; `GET /wp-json/wp/v2/pages/P?context=edit` shows `meta.hk9_sec_hero` object, no nulls.
2. Block save: edit hero heading only → Update → `wp post meta get P hk9_sec_hero` shows new value; `wp post list --post_type=revision --post_parent=P` count increased by exactly 1; `wp post meta get <rev> hk9_sec_hero` equals the page's.
3. Edit heading again + `wp post meta get` on another template's key (`hk9_sec_team`) before/after → unchanged.
4. Restore: edit heading twice (revisions R1, R2), open Revisions → restore R1 → `wp post meta get P hk9_sec_hero` equals `wp post meta get R1 hk9_sec_hero`; front-end renders R1 heading.
5. Block preview (published): change heading, click Preview (no Update) → new tab shows new heading; `wp post meta get P` still old; autosave revision has new value.
6. Classic Editor plugin: repeat 2, 4, 5 (twice consecutively with meta-only changes → both previews show new value).
7. Quick edit: change template via Quick Edit → all `hk9_sec_*` meta unchanged.
8. Template switch in editor: change template, panel reloads, save → new template's key saved, old template's key retained.
9. Cap check: `PUT /pages/P` with `meta` as Subscriber → 401/403; Contributor on own draft → 200.
10. Repeater: add 3 cards, reorder, save → REST array order preserved; revision diff shows readable lines.

## Open risks

- Deleting the user's autosave in the classic preview fallback discards nothing durable, but it is a deliberate override of core's "unchanged → delete" branch (d4).
- Restore leaves R_new with pre-restore meta (c1); optional `wp_restore_post_revision` prio 20 → `wp_save_post_revision()` would add a consistent snapshot at the cost of a redundant revision.
- Draft-by-author REST autosave ignores `meta` (d1); harmless because previews of drafts use `savePost` (d2), but heartbeat autosaves of drafts never carry section meta.
- Gutenberg internals (d2, b2) are ASSUMED stable across minor releases; only built 7.1 JS was inspected.

### Critical Files for Implementation

- /Users/carleykuehner/www/heartland-k9s-for-veterans/wp-content/plugins/heartland-k9s-core/src/Sections/MetaBox.php (render, nonce, `save_post_page`, `admin_action_editpost`, ajax panel, diff filters)
- /Users/carleykuehner/www/heartland-k9s-for-veterans/wp-content/plugins/heartland-k9s-core/assets/js/sections-admin.js (serialise + `editPost({meta})`, template-switch fetch, pickers/repeaters)
- /Users/carleykuehner/www/heartland-k9s-for-veterans/wp-content/plugins/heartland-k9s-core/src/Sections/Accessor.php (`hk9_section()` canonical reader used by theme templates)
- /Users/carleykuehner/www/heartland-k9s-for-veterans/wp-content/plugins/heartland-k9s-core/tests/SectionsSanitizerTest.php (idempotency + schema-validity of sanitizer output, restore/preview integration tests)

## Adversarial review: meta/revisions/preview sub-design

Source used: `7.1-branch` (`$wp_version = '7.1.1-RC1-63589'`), saved under the scratchpad `wpcore/`.

### Spot-checks of claimed VERIFIED behaviors

| Claim | Re-read | Holds? |
|---|---|---|
| a1 | `wp_post_revision_meta_keys()` revision.php:574-599; hooks default-filters.php:800-809 | Yes |
| a2/a3 | `wp_save_post_revision_on_insert` prio 9 (default-filters:445); `post_updated` → `save_post_page` → `save_post` → `wp_after_insert_post` (post.php:5255-5301) | Yes |
| a4 | `wp_save_revisioned_meta_fields` copies only if `metadata_exists()` (revision.php:402-413) | Yes |
| b1 | `update_item`: `wp_update_post(...,false)` :980 → `handle_template` :1015 → `update_additional_fields_for_object` :1033 → `wp_after_insert_post` :1050 | Yes |
| b2 | `requestMetaBoxUpdates` (edit-post.js:9909-9950), `!options.isAutosave` :10022 | Yes |
| c1 | `wp_restore_post_revision_meta`: `delete_post_meta` then `_wp_copy_post_meta` for **every** revisioned key (revision.php:530-544) | Yes |
| d1 | REST `create_post_autosave` :378-451; draft-author branch `wp_update_post` without meta :253 | Yes, plus: REST compares meta with `get_metadata_raw` and returns the **existing** autosave on no-change (:417-420), it does not delete like the classic path |
| d2 | core-data.js:18288-18310 `merged={...persistedRecord,...record}` then keys `title,excerpt,content,meta` | Yes |
| d3 | `_set_preview`/`_wp_preview_meta_filter` revision.php:869-889,1121-1139; uses `get_post()` global and `wp_get_post_autosave($post->ID)` (any user) | Yes |
| d4 | `wp_create_post_autosave` unchanged → `wp_delete_post_revision` + `return 0` (wp-admin/includes/post.php:1984-1990); `admin_action_{$action}` fires from admin.php:418-429 with `$_REQUEST['action']=editpost` **before** post.php:52 remaps to `preview` | Yes, fallback hook choice is valid |
| e1 | `update_value` validates (:194) before sanitising; `update_item` returns the WP_Error (:1034-1036) | Yes |
| g1/g2 | `sanitize_meta` subtype hook (meta.php:1342-1361); `update/add_post_meta` redirect revisions (post.php:2690-2786) | Yes |

### Failure scenarios

**F1 (HIGH, breaks b2 and test step 2): every save creates a revision while any registered key is absent on the page.**
`wp_check_revisioned_meta_fields_have_changed` (revision.php:611-619) compares `get_post_meta($page)` with `get_post_meta($revision)`. `filter_default_metadata` (meta.php:1584-1630) resolves the default by `get_object_subtype()`: `page` → `[default]`, `revision` → `[]` (nothing registered for subtype `revision`). Since all sections for all templates are registered but only the current template's keys are written, at least one key is absent → `[default] !== []` → "changed" on every `wp_after_insert_post`, so the meta-box-loader always produces R2 and no-op Updates create revisions. Also `wp_autosave_post_revisioned_meta_fields` and `_wp_preview_meta_filter` see `''` for the same reason.
Fix: do not pass `default` to `register_post_meta`; put the default in `show_in_rest.schema.default` (used by `get_value` :88-89) and apply defaults in `prepare_callback` and `hk9_section()`. (Alternative: also `register_meta('post',$key,['object_subtype'=>'revision','default'=>...])`.)

**F2 (HIGH, data regression): restore from a revision lacking the key wipes current section meta.**
Verified c1: `delete_post_meta` runs for every key regardless of whether the revision has it. Any revision older than the plugin/section (or created via classic editor before the key existed) restores title and silently deletes hero/cards. Recoverable only via the cosmetic R_new.
Fix: `wp_restore_post_revision` prio 9 captures `get_metadata_raw` for all keys; prio 11 re-adds values for keys where `!metadata_exists('post',$revision_id,$key)` ("absent in revision = untouched").

**F3 (HIGH, save blocked / half-saved): schema validation precedes sanitisation on REST.**
`update_value` validates the JS-mirrored object (:194) before `update_metadata`; with `additionalProperties=false` any unknown/mis-typed field from the bracket parser 400s the whole PUT. Worse, `wp_update_post` at :980 already ran, so title/content are persisted with no revision and no `wp_after_insert_post`, while the editor shows "Updating failed".
Fix: `rest_request_before_callbacks` (or `rest_pre_insert_page` with `$request->set_param('meta',…)`) runs `$def->sanitize()` over `meta.hk9_sec_*` before validation; ship the schema to JS and serialise from it.

**F4 (MEDIUM, phantom data): emptied repeaters cannot be cleared via forms.**
Browsers post nothing for an empty repeater, so `isset($_POST[$key])` is false in `save_post_page`, and `wp_autosave_post_revisioned_meta_fields` requires `!empty()` (:2055-2063). Classic save/preview keeps the old cards.
Fix: emit a hidden `hk9_sec_cards[__present]=1` per section; sanitizer strips it.

**F5 (MEDIUM, stale overwrite): 150 ms debounce races Update.**
Last keystroke may reach only the meta-box-loader; `save_post_page` writes it, but the editor store keeps the PUT response's older meta and re-sends it on the next Update, reverting the edit.
Fix: no debounce (mirror synchronously on `input`), or skip section writes in `save_post_page` when `meta-box-loader=1` and rely on REST.

**F6 (LOW): `_wp_preview_meta_filter` requires `get_post()->ID === $object_id`.** Theme must read sections before nested loops or after `wp_reset_postdata()`, else preview shows saved values.

**F7 (LOW, PII): `meta` is in `view` context** (`get_field_schema` :528) → anonymous `GET /wp/v2/pages` exposes all section fields. Fine for rendered content; strip non-rendered fields in `prepare_callback` when `$request['context'] !== 'edit'`.

### Verdict
The cited core behaviours are accurate, but the design is **not sound as written**: F1 falsifies its "no R2" claim, F2 is real data loss on restore, F3 can block saves. All three have small fixes above; with F1-F5 applied the approach holds.

### Critical Files for Implementation
- /Users/carleykuehner/www/heartland-k9s-for-veterans/wp-content/plugins/heartland-k9s-core/src/Sections/Registry.php
- /Users/carleykuehner/www/heartland-k9s-for-veterans/wp-content/plugins/heartland-k9s-core/src/Sections/MetaBox.php
- /Users/carleykuehner/www/heartland-k9s-for-veterans/wp-content/plugins/heartland-k9s-core/src/Sections/Accessor.php
- /Users/carleykuehner/www/heartland-k9s-for-veterans/wp-content/plugins/heartland-k9s-core/assets/js/sections-admin.js
- /Users/carleykuehner/www/heartland-k9s-for-veterans/wp-content/plugins/heartland-k9s-core/tests/SectionsSanitizerTest.php

# Sub-design 2: URL ownership, rewrites, legacy redirects, registry privacy

Core source: WordPress `7.1-branch` (version.php reports `7.1.1-RC1`), saved under `scratchpad/wpcore/`.

## Decision

- Pages own listing URLs; CPTs use `rewrite.slug` equal to the Page slug, `has_archive => false`, `with_front => false`. No child pages under listing Pages (admin guard).
- Legacy 301 layer runs on `parse_request` priority 1 (before the main query, `handle_404`, `wp_old_slug_redirect`, `redirect_canonical`). Loose 404 guessing replaced by a deterministic exact-slug resolver via `pre_redirect_guess_404_permalink`.
- `hk9_barkode`: `public => false, publicly_queryable => true, exclude_from_search => true, show_ui => true, show_in_rest => false, embeddable => false, has_archive => false`.
- Storage: single autoloaded option keyed by normalized source; targets stored as post IDs where possible.

## Verified core behaviors

| # | Behavior | Ref |
|---|---|---|
| V1 | Rule merge order: `extra_rules_top` (all CPT/taxonomy permastructs) first, page rules after `date_rewrite`; with `/%postname%/` `use_verbose_page_rules=true` so page rules precede post rules | `WP_Rewrite::rewrite_rules()` L1408-1458; `init()` L1941-1945 |
| V2 | CPT single regex is `{slug}/([^/]+)(?:/([0-9]+))?/?$`; never matches bare `{slug}`. Also generates `{slug}/[^/]+/([^/]+)/?$ => attachment=` (swallows `/events/x/y/`) and `{slug}/([^/]+)/embed/?$` unconditionally | `WP_Post_Type::add_rewrite_rules()` L722, L746; `generate_rewrite_rules()` L1109, L1177, L1200 |
| V3 | `has_archive` adds `{slug}/?$` at `top`, which would steal the Page URL, so it must be false | L725-733 |
| V4 | First matching rule wins; `pagename=` matches are validated with `get_page_by_path()` and skipped if no page | `WP::parse_request()` L229-265 |
| V5 | `post_type` query var is stripped for non-`publicly_queryable` types; query var mapping only for viewable types | L313-317, L376-387 |
| V6 | `main()` order: parse_request, query_posts, handle_404, send_headers (`wp_headers` filter L563), then `wp`; `template_redirect` later, with `wp_old_slug_redirect` and `redirect_canonical` both at priority 10 | `WP::main()` L819-840; default-filters L484, L687 |
| V7 | `handle_404()` returns 200 for `is_tag() && get_queried_object()` with zero posts; queried object comes from `get_term_by('slug')` regardless of count | class-wp.php L784-795; `WP_Query::get_queried_object()` |
| V8 | `redirect_guess_404_permalink()` does `post_name LIKE 'x%'` with no ORDER BY across viewable types with `exclude_from_search=false`; `pre_redirect_guess_404_permalink` short-circuits when non-null | canonical.php L941-1011 |
| V9 | `wp_old_slug_redirect` is post-type scoped, so `/hk923-005/` (type `post`) can never find an `hk9_barkode` | query.php `_find_post_by_old_slug` |

## Redirect layer design

Data (`hk9_redirects`, autoload yes):
```
['version'=>1,'rules'=>[ '/hk923-005/' => ['to'=>['type'=>'post','id'=>123] | ['type'=>'path','path'=>'/stories/'],
  'status'=>301,'query'=>[],'seed'=>true,'enabled'=>true,'note'=>'','updated'=>ts,'by'=>uid ] ]]
```
Key normalization: urldecode, lowercase, leading and trailing slash; query-string rules key as `/?k=v` (sorted). Seed rows installed on activation and on version bump (`admin_init`), never overwriting edits; record rows resolve `post_name` to a post ID after migration.

Runtime (`parse_request` priority 1): skip if `rest_route`, `is_admin`, method not GET/HEAD. Build candidate keys from `$wp->request` and `$_GET`; one `isset` lookup, no chain following. Target `post` must be `publish` else fall through. Preserve incoming query string (minus consumed key). `wp_safe_redirect($url, $status, 'hk9-legacy')` plus `Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400`; on save call `litespeed_purge_url` for source if available.

Save-time validation: reject source == target; reject target that is itself a source (offer collapse); warn when other rules target this source (chain); warn when source resolves to live content (`url_to_postid`); loopback HEAD with `redirection => 0` expecting 200 (warning only). Status choices 301/302/410.

Admin: Tools > Legacy Redirects (`manage_options`), WP_List_Table, add/edit form with page/record picker or path, Test button, seed rows disable-only. WP-CLI: `wp hk9 redirects list|add|delete|seed|test [--all] [--http]` (offline resolver assertions by default, real HTTP with `--http`, non-zero exit on failure).

Robots: `wp_robots` filter adds `noindex,nofollow` on `is_singular('hk9_barkode')`; `wp_headers` filter adds `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow`; also `wp_sitemaps_post_types` unset as belt-and-braces.

## Failure scenarios

**F1. Record enumeration via query vars (privacy, MEDIUM).** `hk9_barkode` has `has_archive=false`, so `/?post_type=hk9_barkode` is classified `is_home` (`class-wp-query.php` L1003-1007, L1050-1054; the page_on_front correction at L1058-1067 does not apply because `post_type` is a key). `handle_404` returns 200 for `is_home`. Result: `/?post_type=hk9_barkode`, `/?post_type=hk9_barkode&feed=rss2` (full RSS of every record, no noindex), `/?post_type=hk9_barkode&s=hk9` all list records. `exclude_from_search`, the sitemap filter and `wp_robots` on `is_singular` do not cover this.
Fix: `pre_get_posts` (main query, front end, not singular): if `post_type` contains `hk9_barkode`, force 404 (`$q->set_404(); status_header(404);` or `$q->set('post_type', 'post')` plus `set_404`). Add test rows for those three URLs expecting 404.

**F2. Redirect loop when a target page slug is edited to equal a source (HIGH, sticky).** Rule `/success/` -> page "Stories" (ID). Editor renames Stories slug to `success`. Now `/success/` 301s to `/success/` forever; browsers cache the 301 and `Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400` pins it at the CDN. Save-time "source == target" only compares at save time.
Fix: at runtime, build the target URL, normalize its path with the same key normalizer, and fall through if it equals the source key. Also hook `post_updated` to flag affected rules in admin.

**F3. Listing pagination 404s (wrong URL resolution, MEDIUM).** `/stories/page/2/` matches the CPT single rule first (`([^/]+)` = `page`, `(?:/([0-9]+))?` = `/2`) and 404s, because `extra_rules_top` precedes `page_rewrite`. Same for `/events/page/N/`, `/campaigns/page/N/`, `/barkode/page/N/`. The test plan only covers `/news/page/2/` (posts page, which uses no CPT slug).
Fix: for each listing Page slug, `add_rewrite_rule("{slug}/page/([0-9]+)/?$", "index.php?pagename={slug}&paged=\$matches[1]", 'top')` (verified to sort before permastruct rules), or state that listings paginate via query string/AJAX and add explicit tests either way.

**F4. Seed rows never resolved if migration runs after activation (duplicate/broken redirects, MEDIUM).** "Record rows resolve `post_name` to a post ID after migration" is a one-shot; if the record does not exist yet, the row stays unresolved and QR scans 404.
Fix: store `['type'=>'record','slug'=>...]` and resolve lazily at runtime via `get_page_by_path($slug, OBJECT, 'hk9_barkode')` (cached), falling back to the `/barkode/` page when the record is missing or unpublished (a 404 on a printed QR code is worse than landing on the listing).

**F5. Legacy layer shadows live content (LOW).** Any rule whose source later becomes a real page/post silently wins (runs before parse). Save-time `url_to_postid` is warning-only.
Fix: keep the warning, but add an `enabled=false` auto-flag when `post_updated` creates a collision, surfaced in the list table.

**F6. `?p=N` enumeration (LOW, accepted).** `/?p=123` for a barkode record triggers `redirect_canonical` L122-133 and 301s to `/barkode/<slug>/` because the type is publicly viewable. Inherent to `publicly_queryable=true`; note it in the design as accepted.

**F7. Media metadata via REST (LOW).** `show_in_rest=false` on the parent does not hide attachments: `/wp-json/wp/v2/media?parent=<id>` exposes title/caption/alt of images attached to published records. If captions carry veteran names, filter `rest_attachment_query` or scrub captions on import.

**F8. Stale rewrite rules (LOW).** No mention of `flush_rewrite_rules()` on activation/deactivation or when a listing Page slug changes. Add both, plus the `hk9_barkode_rewrite_rules` filter must be registered before flush.

## Verdict

Core claims are sound (10 of 11 spot-checked hold outright; V11 needs the "explicit post_type bypasses exclude_from_search" caveat). The design is not yet safe to ship because of F1 (enumeration via `?post_type=`/feed/search) and F2 (runtime loop guard missing). F3 is a functional gap the test plan would not catch. All four fixes are small and localized to `Registrar.php` (F1, F3, F8) and `Resolver.php`/`Store.php` (F2, F4, F5).

### Plugin design
**Table** `wp_hk9_import_map`: `source_key VARCHAR(191) UNIQUE, object_type, object_id, sha256 CHAR(64) NULL (attachments), created_by_run VARCHAR(32) NULL, last_run, payload_hash, field_hashes JSON, before JSON (pre-image of updated fields), status`. Postmeta has an index only on `meta_key` (schema.php), so the table gives real uniqueness plus fast lookup; meta mirrors are for WP_Query/REST/repair.

**State** (`hk9_import_state`, autoload no): `{run_id, payload_dir, mode:{dry_run,overwrite}, status: idle|running|paused|failed|done, step, cursor, totals, counts[step]:{create,update,skip,conflict,fail}, errors[], lock:{token,expires}, started_at, updated_at}`. Runs history + option backups in `hk9_import_runs`; log at `uploads/hk9-import/<run>.log` (dir has `.htaccess`/`index.html`; download via admin-post + nonce). No lock or state is touched on activation (activation only runs dbDelta).

**Steps (ordered, each cursor-resumable, ~20 s time budget or N records per call):** `validate` (manifest schema, `validate_file()`, sha256 of every file, MIME allowlist, size caps, template names against `wp_get_theme()->get_page_templates()`, token graph) → `terms` (`term_exists`/`wp_insert_term`) → `media_files` → `media_sizes` → `posts_stub` → `posts_resolve` → `menus` → `options` → `reading` → `redirects` → `finalize`.

- `media_files`: dedupe by sha256 (map table, then `_hk9_sha256` meta); copy file to `wp_tempnam()`, `media_handle_sideload($file_array, 0, null, ['post_title','post_excerpt'=>caption,'post_content','post_date','meta_input'=>[_hk9_source_key,_hk9_sha256,_hk9_import_run]])` with `intermediate_image_sizes_advanced` filtered to `[]` for this step (only the `-scaled`/rotated original and base meta are produced); then `update_post_meta(_wp_attachment_image_alt)`. Because `meta_input` lands in the same insert, a timeout after insert but before the map row is written is still recovered by the meta lookup.
- `media_sizes`: `wp_update_image_subsizes($id)` per attachment; safe to re-run.
- `posts_stub`: `wp_insert_post(wp_slash([...title, name, status, type, date, post_content=>'']))`, `_hk9_import_pending=1`. No parent/template yet.
- `posts_resolve`: resolve tokens in content/meta/parent/featured; write `_wp_page_template`, `wp_set_object_terms`, `_thumbnail_id`; compute `field_hashes` (sha256 of canonical `wp_json_encode` with sorted keys) per field and store; clear pending flag.
- `menus`: map key → `nav_menu` term (adopt existing by name, `created_by_run=NULL` so it is never rolled back); items in depth order with `menu-item-status=>'publish'`, `menu-item-object-id` for post_type kinds; locations merged into `nav_menu_locations`.
- `options`: snapshot current value into run `before`, deep-merge (default) or replace, per-key hashes.
- `reading`: assert both targets are published pages and differ; order `page_on_front`, `page_for_posts`, then `show_on_front` (validated to `page|posts`).
- `redirects`: merge into `hk9_redirects` option keyed by `from` (served by the redirect sub-design).

**Idempotency + conflict algorithm (per record):** `map = lookup(key)`; none → CREATE. Else for each field f: `current_h = hash(live f)`; if `current_h == stored_h[f]` → field untouched → apply if payload changed; else CONFLICT → skip f (record counted `conflict`) unless `--overwrite`, which applies and re-records hashes. Payload-unchanged and no conflicts → SKIP. Dry-run performs the same walk without writes.

**Rollback (`--run=ID`):** reverse order over map rows with `created_by_run == ID`: menu items → menus (`wp_delete_nav_menu`) → posts (`wp_delete_post($id,true)`) → attachments (`wp_delete_attachment($id,true)`) → terms; each only if all `field_hashes` still match (unchanged) or `--force`; otherwise report "skipped: modified". Options/reading: restore `before` value (or delete if absent) only if current hash equals the imported hash or `--force`. Records merely *updated* by the run get their `before` field values restored under the same rule. Preexisting content and menus adopted by name are untouched by construction.

**Endpoints / UX:** REST `POST hk9/v1/import/{start,step,pause,rollback}` (`permission_callback` → `manage_options`, `X-WP-Nonce`); admin page under Tools (payload dir restricted by `realpath` to `uploads/hk9-payload/`), buttons Dry run / Import (overwrite checkbox) / Pause, progress bar (step x/11, records m/n, MB copied), per-step count table, error list (key, step, message, retry), Download log, Rollback (type `ROLLBACK`), Reset state (clears option only). Sensitive records log key + hash only.

**CLI:** `wp hk9 import <dir> [--dry-run] [--overwrite] [--resume] [--step=<name>] [--batch=<n>] [--allow-fetch] --user=<admin>` (refuses without an admin user), `wp hk9 status [--run=] [--format=json]`, `wp hk9 rollback --run=<id> [--force] [--yes]`, `wp hk9 redirects test [--from=<path>]`, `wp hk9 reset-state --yes`. Optional fetch: `wp_safe_remote_get` with `stream`, `filename`, `timeout`, `limit_response_size`, then sha256 + `wp_check_filetype_and_ext` before use.

### Edge cases
Slug collision with a preexisting page → `wp_unique_post_slug` suffix, warned, no duplicate on rerun. Parent/token missing → record fails, others proceed. Thumbnails previously uploaded by hand → adopted by sha256, not rolled back. Records dropped from a newer payload → reported as orphans, never deleted. `-scaled` originals → `{{media_url}}` returns the scaled URL, `|original` the original. Two-phase update creates one revision per post (acceptable). Stale lock after a fatal → expires; `--resume` reacquires. Block validity checked by comparing `parse_blocks()` counts before/after rewriting.

### Test plan (docker WP + WP-CLI)
1. Fresh: `--dry-run` → create=N, update/skip=0; import; assert page count, map row count, `page_on_front` = mapped id, `_wp_attached_file` ends `-scaled.jpg` and metadata has `original_image` for the 18 MB image, alt set, `wp menu item list primary` shows object ids, `grep -c '{{'` on all post_content = 0.
2. Rerun: create=0; counts of posts/attachments/terms/menu items/options and `ls uploads/**` unchanged.
3. `wp post update <id> --post_title=Edited` + change `hk9_hero` meta; rerun → conflict=1, title still `Edited`.
4. Rerun `--overwrite` → title/meta revert; rerun again → skip.
5. Create manual page + manual upload before import; import; edit one imported page; `rollback --run` → imported posts/attachments/menus gone, edited page reported skipped, manual page/upload intact, `show_on_front` restored; `--force` removes the edited page.
6. `timeout 10 wp hk9 import … --step=media_files`; `status` shows cursor; `--resume` finishes; attachment count = payload count.
7. Delete one media file from payload → per-item failure listed; run completes; fixing file + `--resume` imports only it.

### Open risks
GD/Imagick memory for 18 MB originals (`WP_MAX_MEMORY_LIMIT`); object-cache staleness of the state option across concurrent REST polls and CLI (single writer enforced by lock); hash canonicalization must be byte-stable (sorted keys, normalized line endings); kses in CLI without `--user`; menus adopted by name may already contain editor-added items (not deleted on rollback, by design).

## Adversarial review: Sub-design 3 (importer)

Core re-read from cached `WordPress/7.1-branch` (`$wp_version = '7.1.1-RC1-63589'`, `scratchpad/wpcore/`).

### Spot-checks of VERIFIED claims

| Claim | Result |
|---|---|
| `media_handle_sideload()` media.php:466 `test_form=>false`, 513-522 `$post_data` merge, 530-532 EXIF alt, 535 metadata | **Holds.** Caveat: `wp_insert_attachment()` (post.php:6778) does *not* `wp_slash`, so `$post_data` must be pre-slashed like the stub path. |
| `_wp_handle_upload()` file.php:936 `is_readable`, 941 `filesize`, 961 `wp_check_filetype_and_ext`, 991 `wp_unique_filename`, 1025-1026 `copy()+unlink()` | **Holds** exactly. |
| `wp_create_image_subsizes()` image.php:285 threshold, 340 `-scaled`, 395 meta saved before sizes, 437-447 skip existing names, `wp_update_image_subsizes()` 159-191 resumable | **Holds.** Note 299: HEIC/HEIF is converted to JPEG by default (media.php:6542); exclude from MIME allowlist or expect a different extension. |
| `wp_update_nav_menu_item()` 545 draft-by-default, 488 URL blanked, 514-516 title sync, "parent must be an existing item DB id (589)" | **Partially wrong.** 589 just stores `(int)` parent; the only guard is self-parent reset (584-585). Core never validates the parent exists, so a stale mapped parent id silently orphans the child. |
| `_reset_front_page_settings_for_post` (post.php:4035, hooked default-filters:593/595), `_wp_delete_post_menu_item` (472), `page_on_front` absint (formatting.php:4953-4954) | **Holds** (line numbers off by one). |
| `wp_insert_post()`: `wp_unslash` 4981, `tax_input` cap gate 5105, `page_template` WP_Error after insert 5158-5166 | **Holds.** Also verified: `meta_input` (5111), `_thumbnail_id` (5135-5151) and `_wp_page_template` all run *before* `do_action('post_updated')` at 5255. |
| `kses` in CLI | ASSUMED claim is right: `kses_init` is hooked to `set_current_user` (default-filters:607), so `--user=<admin with unfiltered_html>` works. |

### Failure scenarios (severity, minimal fix)

1. **Wrong URLs baked into content (HIGH).** `posts_resolve` replaces `{{post_url:K}}` while other pages are still stubs: `_get_page_link()` (link-template.php:428-445) returns `?page_id=N` for non-published posts and builds `get_page_uri()` from the *current* parent chain, which is set in the same step. Home page URL is also wrong until `reading` sets `page_on_front`. Rerun does not fix it (payload hash unchanged → SKIP). *Fix:* split into `posts_hierarchy` (parent, slug, status, template, terms, featured for all posts, parent-first) → `reading` → `posts_content` (token bake). Also `validate` must reject empty `permalink_structure`.

2. **Spurious slug suffixes (HIGH for hierarchical sites).** Stubs are published with `post_parent=0`, so two legitimate `/about/team/` and `/programs/team/` collide in `wp_unique_post_slug()` (post.php:5600-5634 checks `post_parent`) and the second permanently becomes `team-2`. *Fix:* insert stubs as `draft` (uniqueness skipped, post.php:5561-5565); assign parent + slug + final status in the hierarchy pass. This also stops empty published pages being publicly visible/indexed if resolve fails.

3. **Import revision snapshots empty meta (MEDIUM, violates the revision requirement).** `wp_save_post_revision` fires on `post_updated` (5255) during the `posts_resolve` `wp_update_post()` and copies revisioned meta then (`_wp_put_post_revision` → `wp_save_revisioned_meta_fields`, default-filters:803). Meta written afterwards is not in the revision; restoring it blanks `hk9_hero`. *Fix:* pass meta via slashed `meta_input` (and `_thumbnail_id`, `page_template`) in the same `wp_update_post()` call.

4. **Rollback loses `show_on_front` (MEDIUM; test step 5 will fail).** Deleting the imported front page triggers `_reset_front_page_settings_for_post` → `show_on_front=posts`, `page_on_front=0`; the reading restore then sees "current hash != imported hash" and skips. *Fix:* restore options/reading/redirects *first* in rollback, before deleting posts.

5. **False conflicts on every rerun (MEDIUM).** If `field_hashes` are computed from payload values, kses/`sanitize_meta`/date normalisation make DB values differ, so rerun #1 reports `conflict=N`. *Fix:* compute stored hashes by re-reading `get_post()`/`get_post_meta()` immediately after each write.

6. **ISO dates reach MySQL (MEDIUM).** `wp_resolve_post_date()` (post.php:5520) only regex-checks the `YYYY-MM-DD` prefix; `2024-03-01T10:00:00Z` is stored raw (strict mode rejects; otherwise truncates). *Fix:* in `validate`, convert to `post_date_gmt = gmdate('Y-m-d H:i:s', ts)` and `post_date = get_date_from_gmt()`.

7. **Payload/log publicly downloadable (HIGH for `sensitive` records).** `uploads/hk9-payload/` and `uploads/hk9-import/*.log` are web-served; `.htaccess` is ignored on nginx/fpm images. *Fix:* directory name with `wp_generate_password(32)` stored in state, `Options -Indexes`/deny rules, and delete the payload on `finalize`; or accept CLI paths outside the web root only.

8. **Duplicate creation race (MEDIUM).** Lock is option read-modify-write (non-atomic, cache-stale). Two REST `step` calls can both pass "lookup none" → two posts, second map insert fails on UNIQUE → orphan. *Fix:* reserve the map row (`INSERT source_key, status=reserved`) *before* creating the object, and take the lock via a single `UPDATE ... WHERE token IS NULL OR expires < NOW()` with affected-rows check.

9. **Redirect loops / shadowed pages (MEDIUM).** `from=/about/` with `to={{post_url}}` resolving to `/about/`, or A→B, B→A. *Fix:* in `redirects`, normalise `to` to a path, reject `from==to`, walk the merged table for cycles, warn if `url_to_postid(from)` hits a published post.

10. **Wrong theme at import time (LOW).** `nav_menu_locations` goes to `theme_mods_{stylesheet}` and template validation uses `wp_get_theme()`. *Fix:* `validate` asserts the expected stylesheet is active.

11. **Manual-upload adoption is not implemented (LOW).** Pre-existing attachments lack `_hk9_sha256`, so the "adopted by sha256" edge case never fires; either hash existing attachments in `validate` or drop the claim.

### Verdict
Core citations are accurate except the nav-menu parent claim. The design is **not sound as written** because of items 1-4: URL/slug correctness depends on step ordering that the current `posts_stub`/`posts_resolve` split gets wrong, the import revision violates the revision requirement, and rollback provably fails its own test 5. All fixes are ordering/plumbing changes, not architectural.
